title: Deep Learning Assisted FEM
short: Hybrid FEM + DNN framework that uses uncertainty to decide when to trust the network, cutting compute time by ~55%.
description: Accelerating optimization by combining high-fidelity FEM simulations with deep neural networks. Uncertainty quantification decides, per query, whether to rely on the DNN prediction or fall back to a full FEM solve. The aim is a generalized hybrid framework that balances accuracy and efficiency.
highlights: ~55% reduction in computational time
Uncertainty-driven switching between FEM and DNN
Guided by Dr Manish Agrawal (Jul 2024 - Dec 2024)

title: Inverse Kinematics using Deep Neural Network
short: Inverse kinematics for non-standard DH parameters of a modular robot using a deep neural network.
description: A deep neural network that solves inverse kinematics for robot arms whose modules produce non-zero twists and non-standard DH parameters, where closed-form solutions are hard to derive. Built alongside the modular robotic arm research kit at IIT Ropar.
highlights: Works for non-standard DH parameter configurations
Validated on the Puma 560 arm
Part of work with Dr. Ekta Singla

title: Electrical Resistance Tomography
short: Detecting and locating cracks in a composite sample by inverse conductivity mapping.
description: Current is passed through electrodes on a sample sheet of nonlinear, anisotropic, homogeneous conductivity and voltage patterns are measured at the periphery. A deep learning model builds an inverse conductivity map that predicts the presence and location of a defect directly from the voltages.
highlights: Inverse mapping from boundary voltages to defect location
Collaboration between IIT Kanpur and IIT Ropar
Dr Prabhat Agnihotri and Dr Nandini Gupta (Jul 2023 - Apr 2024)

title: Soft Robotic Gripper
short: A glove-controlled, pneumatically actuated soft gripper designed for patients with diabetic neuropathy.
description: A wearable glove with flex sensors captures finger stimuli and transmits them over Wi-Fi to control a five-fingered soft gripper made from Polydimethylsiloxane. The fingers are pneumatically operated; molds were 3D printed and the design was modeled in SolidWorks.
highlights: Flex-sensor glove with Wi-Fi control
Five-finger PDMS gripper, pneumatic actuation
3D-printed molds, SolidWorks design

title: Heterogeneous Drone Swarming
short: Swarm of nano and large drones for flood surveillance and delivery of first-aid supplies.
description: Designed a nano drone with a 3D-printed nylon body reinforced with carbon fiber and LoRa support to talk to the ground control station and other drones, plus larger drones to carry first aid and critical supplies. A swarm was simulated for surveillance and aid in flood situations, including autonomous operators that mimic human decision-making, with different flight times per drone.
highlights: LoRa communication between drones and GCS
Disaster-management swarm simulation
Guided by Dr Shashi Jha, Dr Sudeepta Mishra and Dr Shrikant Padhee

title: Defect Detection using Deep Learning
short: Predicting material defects from a small dataset using a DNN with PCA and auto-encoder pre-trained weights.
description: Deep learning techniques to predict material defects for a small dataset, using a deep neural network combined with PCA and pre-trained weights from auto-encoders to overcome limited data.
highlights: Works on a small dataset
PCA + auto-encoder pretraining

title: Checkers Game
short: Human vs. computer English Draughts with an Alpha-Beta Pruning AI that is fast and hard to beat.
description: A Human vs. Computer Checkers (English Draughts) game on an 8x8 board, implemented on a game-tree structure with Alpha-Beta Pruning to sharpen the computer's strategic decision-making while keeping its moves fast.
highlights: Game tree search with Alpha-Beta Pruning
Fast decisions, difficult to beat

title: Modular Robotic Arm Kit
short: Educational kit of interconnecting modules forming a serial manipulator, with auto-generated URDF files.
description: Designed an educational robotic kit with modular components that interconnect into a serial manipulator. Each module has adjustable angles, supporting configurations with non-zero twists. Developed an algorithm that dynamically generates URDF files from the current module configuration.
highlights: Adjustable-angle modules, non-zero twists
Dynamic URDF generation
With Dr. Ekta Singla (Apr 2023 - Jul 2023)

title: SLM Cache as an Adaptive Cache layerfor LLMs
short: Small Language Models (SLMs) as semantic caches to reduce the frequency and cost of LLM invocations
description: Designed an educational robotic kit with modular components that interconnect into a serial manipulator. Each module has adjustable angles, supporting configurations with non-zero twists. Developed an algorithm that dynamically generates URDF files from the current module configuration.
highlights: Reduces the frequency and cost of LLM invocations
Uses Small Language Models (SLMs) as semantic caches

title: Institutional Modeling for a Sustainable Environment
short: An evolutionary game theory model of institutions that promote environmental sustainability through incentives, voting, and memory.
description: Integrated concepts from ecology and finance into an evolutionary game theory framework to model institutions for environmental sustainability. Incorporated voting, memory, rewards, and penalties to design institutional mechanisms aimed at mitigating the tragedy of the commons, reducing oscillatory behavior, and preventing environmental degradation.
highlights: Evolutionary game theory applied to environmental sustainability
Institutional mechanisms using voting, memory, rewards, and penalties
Guided by Dr. Parth S. Dutta

title: Ornithopter
short: A mechanical power transmission system that converts BLDC motor rotation into the flapping motion of aircraft wings.
description: Designed a mechanical power transmission system for an ornithopter, using gears and a crank mechanism to convert the rotational motion of a brushless DC motor into the complex flapping motion of the wings. Focused on developing an efficient mechanical arrangement for biomimetic flight.
highlights: Gear-and-crank-based power transmission mechanism
Conversion of rotary motion into wing-flapping motion
Guided by Dr. Sudeepta Mishra

title: Night Watch: AI-Based Suspicious Activity Detection
short: An AI-based system that analyzes camera footage to identify suspicious activity associated with bicycle theft.
description: Developed an AI model to identify suspicious activity related to bicycle theft using camera footage. The project explored computer vision and video-based activity analysis for security monitoring.
highlights: AI-based suspicious activity detection
Analysis of camera footage
Application of computer vision to security monitoring

title: CNC G-Code Converter for CNC Cutting
short: A Python utility that converts 3D-printing G-code into CNC-compatible G-code by adapting parameters to the required cutting layer.
description: Developed a Python script to convert G-code generated from an STL file for 3D printing into CNC-compatible G-code. The converter adjusts parameters according to the desired layer to adapt the original toolpath instructions for CNC cutting.
highlights: Python-based G-code conversion
Conversion of 3D-printing toolpaths for CNC cutting
Layer-dependent parameter adjustment

title: A comprehensive high-order solver verification methodology for free fluid flows
short: A systematic approach to assess the performance of high-order solvers for free fluid flows, comparing results with traditional methods using L2 and L∞ norms.
description: Used a comprehensive methodology to verify the performance of high-order solvers for free fluid flows. The approach provides a systematic framework to assess solver accuracy and efficiency, comparing results with traditional verification methods using L2 and L∞ norms. The methodology aims to reduce the time and effort required for solver verification while ensuring reliable performance assessment.
highlights: Reduced the time and effort required for solver verification by providing a systematic approach to assess solver performance.
Compared the results with traditional approaches using L2 and L∞ norms, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed methodology in accurately assessing solver performance.

title: Egocentric Emotional Context Analysis
short: Analyzing emotional states and contextual cues from an egocentric perspective from your regular goggles.
description: Using your regualr goggles we took multiple inputs and used it to make a SOTA multi-modal model to predict the emotional state and then a SLM would help in responding to the user in a more human-like manner. The model would also take into account the context of the situation and the user's surroundings to provide more accurate predictions.
highlights: Uses multi-modal inputs to predict emotional states from an egocentric perspective to SOTA performance.
The whole hardware was made to fit in your regular spectacles
A SLM was used to respond to the user in a more human-like manner, taking into account the context of the situation and the user's surroundings.
